settings.content: These describe offers that Shopify actually applies through automatic discounts (Discounts). Change a discount there and change it here too, or the store will promise a price the cart won't charge. Quantity tiers live on each product, in the 'Quantity offer' metafield.

settings.label: Product A
settings.info: The product that receives the saving (the ‘customer gets’ side of the Buy X Get Y discount).

settings.label: Product B
settings.info: The ‘customer buys’ side. The saving applies once per order. Shopify drops it when the bag has 3 or more of B with only 1–2 of A (e.g. 1 GODA + 3 HOYGI), so the theme never promises it for those bags.

settings.label: Pair saving, in cents
settings.info: Must equal the pair discount’s amount off (800 = $8).

settings.label: Pair discount title
settings.info: Must match the automatic discount's title exactly. The cart uses it to confirm the saving really applied before it says so.

settings.content: The makers’ own packshots, one or more per option, used wherever the theme shows a product (line-up, product page gallery, pair, bag). Slots are read in order. Variant ID: open the product in Shopify admin, choose the option, and copy the number at the end of the address (…/variants/49337208045819). A product with no slot uses its Shopify product images.
Shopify takes the homepage title and description from Online Store > Preferences. These are used instead while those are empty or just the shop name.

settings.label: Homepage title
settings.default: ZOREV — Perfume oil and balm stick, free shipping worldwide

settings.label: Homepage meta description
settings.default: GODA, a 15 ml perfume oil worn from a dropper, and HOYGI, a 9 g balm stick that goes on dry. Savings apply in your bag; free tracked shipping worldwide.
settings.info: About 150 characters: search results cut descriptions off at roughly 155.

settings.label: Support email
settings.info: Shown in the footer and used for support links.

settings.label: Show a returns line on product pages
settings.info: Leave off. The published refund policy lists personal care goods as non-returnable, which covers every product in this store. Turn on only after the policy allows returns of these items and the product page wording has been checked against it.
